QuestInfo.name: The Wanderer's Whereabouts 1
QuestInfo.1: #bSyras the Ticket Agent#k at Ariant Station claims the suspicious wanderer headed to Orbis and that you should talk to #bIsa#k at Orbis Station.
QuestInfo.2: You meet Isa the station guide as Syras instructed. Isa says an absent-minded man asked her directions to Leafre. She added that he was rather strange.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: #bTalk to Isa the Station Guide in Orbis
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
EXP 99,190
Can proceed to 'The Wanderer's Whereabouts 2' quest
Can proceed to the 'Nex the Time Guard' quest

0.0: He made a scene because he wanted to get going before schedule. I didn't know what to do. I tried to calm him down, but I couldn't understand his gibberish. Anyway, he got on the earliest airship and left for Orbis.
0.1: Now that I think about it, he was rather strange and awkward. If you're looking for that man, I recommend heading over to Orbis. Oh! Talk to #bIsa#k the station guide at Orbis Station. She'd remember the man if she saw him.

yes.0: The ship is about to take off. If you want to go to Orbis, I suggest you hurry.

no.0: What? That's not the right guy? Then ask someone else, huh? I'm a busy guy.

1.0: Hello, welcome to Orbis Station. My name is Isa. How can I help you? \r\n#b#L0#I'm looking for someone. Have you seen a suspicious fellow wearing a cape wrapped around his entire body?#l\n#k
1.1: A suspicious fellow? Hmm, I do remember a couple of people wearing big capes, but they weren't exactly suspicious. There was a magician who seemed to be into flashy capes and a warrior who was headed to Victoria Island. And...\r\n#b#L0#Was there someone who seemed a bit absent-minded? Who arrived from Ariant early in the morning.#l\n#k
1.2: Oh, yes! That guy? He left for Leafre as soon as he got here. As you know, Orbis Station is always so hectic. He didn't know where to go, so I helped him find his way, although he seemed a bit uncomfortable around me for some reason.

npc.0: Talk to Isa at Orbis Station.
